notes: Condo buildings first in US ACTIVE markets. Scout scans high volume (40+ listings/market); only RESEARCH listings that pass yield screen. Defer new international scouting until Tampa, Jacksonville, Birmingham, Memphis, and Cleveland each have ≥3 RESEARCH candidates or documented dry-market rationale. See data/pipeline-status.json for current gap.

asset_focus.rationale: Multi-unit condo buildings offer repeatable comps, known HOA, and cluster opportunities; SFH/townhouse are secondary.

scout_instructions.screening_threshold: Rough gross yield must be >= target_yield_minimum (10%) to pass to RESEARCH. Reject below 10%.
scout_instructions.defer_non_us_markets: Do not add new Manta/Cuenca/international RESEARCH candidates until all US ACTIVE markets in market_sweep_order have ≥3 RESEARCH candidates or a documented dry-market note in scout_notes.

strategy: Filter each market for Condo / Condominium only before SFH or townhouse.
Search by building name or street address when a condo complex has multiple active listings.
When one unit in a building passes yield screen, review other units in the same building.
Prefer established condo buildings (20+ units) with published HOA fees on the listing.
Record building_name and unit in meta.json when available.
building_signals: Multiple units for sale in same building
Lower price per sqft vs neighborhood SFH

hoa_screening.quick_adjusted_yield: For condos with stated HOA, also compute (monthly_rent - hoa_monthly) * 12 / price; flag if below 8% even when gross yield passes.
